# AMD FidelityFX SDK v1.1.4 (subset)

The files the FSR 3.1 upscaler (`src/video_core/renderer_vulkan/vk_fsr3_upscaler.cpp`) compiles,
unmodified from AMD's FidelityFX SDK v1.1.4 release: `include/FidelityFX/gpu` from the SDK's
`sdk/include/FidelityFX/gpu`, `shaders/fsr3upscaler` from `sdk/src/backends/vk/shaders/fsr3upscaler`.
